CustomField.description: The amber and red flags FSD 5.9.7 rows 2 and 3 require on the dashboard. Purely derived from the refreshed days-past-due, with zero automation behind it - the flag cannot drift out of step with the balance because it has no stored state of its own.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Green under 60 days, Amber at 60, Red at 90.
CustomField.label: Dashboard Flag
